description: Broadcast a signed tx to the chain. [write] Requires user confirmation after transfer preview and prior signing via dex_wallet_sign_transaction. Solana: pass last_valid_block_height from dex_tx_get_sol_unsigned; an expired blockhash is rejected before the upstream send. account_id/address are auto-filled from the login session when omitted.

account_id.description: Account ID (for history_data); optional when logged in — resolved from session

address.description: Sender wallet address (history_data.address); optional when logged in — resolved from session wallet for the chain

chain.description: Chain name: must match dex_chain_config response `chain` (canonical). Aliases are resolved via chain config before calling upstream.

last_valid_block_height.description: Solana: lastValidBlockHeight returned by dex_tx_get_sol_unsigned or the blockhash fetch. Broadcast is rejected when the chain height has passed it.

mcp_token.description: MCP session token obtained from login (dex_auth_google_login_poll or dex_auth_gate_login_poll). MUST be provided in every call to this tool after login; omitting it will result in 403

signed_tx.description: Signed transaction data. For EVM chains: hex string (0x prefix added automatically). For other chains (e.g. Solana): use chain-specific format

name: dex_tx_send_raw_transaction
